propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails with exit 128 when test environment injects git config safe.bareRepository=explicit via GIT_CONFIG_* environment variables
git -C <bare.git> refuses implicit repository discovery under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, but git --git-dir <bare.git> is always permitted
test_ref_lock.py's _git() helper uses git -C against bare fixture repos, violating the established pattern in _git_upkeep.py and test_concurrency_regression.py which use explicit --git-dir naming
the push operation succeeds and objects exist in the bare remote, but verification commands (cat-file, rev-parse) fail because the helper uses -C instead of --git-dir
fix requires adding a _bare_git helper to test_ref_lock.py that uses git --git-dir for bare repository access, routing AC0 test inspections through it while keeping -C for work-tree repos
